documents.basis.cmr: Convention on the Contract for the International Carriage of Goods by Road (CMR), Geneva 19.05.1956, art. 4–9. Own form layout.
documents.basis.transport_order: Polish Civil Code art. 774–804 (carriage and forwarding contracts), Transport Law; international carriage – CMR Convention.
documents.basis.road_card: Record of vehicle work and mileage for cost and fuel accounting (own layout, no official form).
documents.field.loading_place_date: Place and date of taking over the goods
documents.field.dangerous_goods: Dangerous goods (UN, name, class, packing group, tunnel code)
documents.field.payment_terms: Instructions as to payment for carriage
documents.sign.sender: 22. Signature and stamp of the sender
documents.sign.carrier: 23. Signature and stamp of the carrier
documents.sign.consignee: 24. Goods received – date, signature and stamp of the consignee
documents.warn.adr: The vehicle carries dangerous goods – fill in the ADR details.
documents.warn.no_profile: Complete the company document profile (address, licence, liability insurance).
documents.forbidden: You are not allowed to change this.
documents.bad_period: The end of the period is before its start.
documents.number_taken: Could not assign a number – try again.
documents.bad_logo: Invalid logo image (PNG or JPEG, up to 2 MB).
documents.basis.pod: Confirmation of receipt of goods – CMR Convention Art. 8–9 and 30 (checking on acceptance, reservations on delivery), Polish Transport Law Art. 74–76.
documents.field.reservations: Consignee's reservations (condition, loss, damage – CMR Art. 30)
documents.basis.damage_report: Record of loss, damage or delay – CMR Convention art. 17–29 (carrier liability) and art. 30 (reservations: apparent damage on delivery, non-apparent within 7 days, delay within 21 days), art. 32 (1-year limitation); Polish Transport Law art. 74–76 (damage report, claim).
documents.basis.loading_report: Condition, quantity and arrangement of the load when taken over – CMR Convention art. 8–9 (checking the consignment, carrier's reservations), Polish Transport Law; securing – Directive 2014/47/EU (Annex III), EN 12195-1.
documents.field.securing: Securing (straps – number, anti-slip mats, bars, blocking)
documents.basis.posting_declaration: Directive (EU) 2020/1057 Art. 1(11), Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/2179. The declaration is submitted in the public IMI portal (postingdeclaration.eu) before the posting starts – this document collects the data to enter there and serves as the copy for the cab.
documents.text.posting_notes: Submit the declaration in the IMI portal before the posting starts. In the cab: a copy of the declaration, proof of transport (CMR) and tachograph records.
documents.warn.not_posting: The route is a bilateral operation or transit – posting usually does not apply (Directive 2020/1057). Check the loading and unloading countries.
documents.basis.consignment_note: Polish Transport Law of 15.11.1984 (Art. 38–39) – evidence of a domestic contract of carriage; own layout (no official form), fields as in the CMR note.
documents.basis.driver_activity: Commission Decision 2009/959/EU (form, OJ L 330, 16.12.2009), AETR Agreement; Regulation (EU) 165/2014 Art. 34(3) – within the EU replaced by a manual tachograph entry. The form is completed electronically or typed before the journey.
documents.kind.business_trip: Business trip order and expense claim
documents.basis.business_trip: Polish Labour Code Art. 77⁵, Regulation of 29.01.2013 on business travel allowances (per diems, accommodation, lump sums), Act on drivers' working time Art. 21a. Since 2.02.2022 international journeys of drivers are not business trips – posting rules apply.
documents.basis.working_time: Act of 16.04.2004 on drivers' working time Art. 25 (record of driving, other work, availability, breaks and rests), Labour Code Art. 149; trip data – driving time to be checked against tachograph records.
documents.basis.cabin_checklist: Polish Road Transport Act Art. 87 (documents carried), Road Traffic Act Art. 38, Regulation (EU) 165/2014 Art. 36 (tachograph records: current day and previous 56 days), ADR 8.1.2. Checklist for a roadside check from vehicle and driver deadlines.
documents.basis.vehicle_handover: Polish Labour Code Art. 124 § 1(1) (property entrusted with obligation to return) – vehicle condition, equipment, odometer and fuel at handover; own layout.
documents.basis.pallet_note: Agreement of the parties, EPAL pallet exchange rules (no official form) – pallets delivered and returned, balance, quality.
documents.basis.securing_declaration: Directive 2014/47/EU (Art. 13, Annex III), standard EN 12195-1, Polish Road Traffic Act Art. 61 – placing and securing the load against movement.
documents.basis.adr_document: ADR Chapter 5.4.1 (transport document), Polish Act of 19.08.2011 on the carriage of dangerous goods; may be part of the CMR note. Instructions in writing (5.4.3) – official UNECE form, not printed here.
documents.basis.sent_data: Polish Act of 9.03.2017 on the road and rail transport monitoring system (SENT). The notification is filed in PUESC (tax administration) – the system does not send it, it prepares the data and keeps the reference number.
documents.basis.edd_data: Polish Excise Duty Act of 6.12.2008, Council Directive (EU) 2020/262, EMCS PL2 (PUESC). The system does not file the document – it collects the data and the ARC number (also printed in CMR box 5).
documents.basis.oversize_permit_data: Polish Road Traffic Act Art. 64–64i, regulation on abnormal vehicle permit forms (categories I–VII; VII – GDDKiA for a route). The application is filed with the authority – this document collects the data.
documents.field.work_start: Started work at the undertaking on
documents.field.reasons: In the period the driver (mark X)
documents.field.settlement: To be paid / to be returned
documents.text.activity_exempt_vehicle: drove a vehicle exempted from the scope of Regulation (EC) 561/2006 or the AETR
documents.text.activity_statement: I, as a driver, confirm that I have not been driving a vehicle falling under the scope of Regulation (EC) 561/2006 or the AETR during the period mentioned above.
documents.text.trip_notes: Per diems under the Regulation of 29.01.2013 – check the rates and border crossing times. Drivers in international transport (since 2.02.2022): the journey is not a business trip – pay under posting rules (Art. 21a of the Act on drivers' working time).
documents.text.working_time_notes: Driving time from trips recorded in the system – add other work, availability, breaks and rests from tachograph records.
documents.text.handover_notes: The driver accepts the vehicle and equipment as property entrusted with the obligation to return it (Labour Code Art. 124).
documents.text.securing_statement: I declare that the load has been placed and secured against movement in accordance with EN 12195-1 and the EU cargo securing guidelines (Directive 2014/47/EU), and that axle loads and total weight do not exceed the permitted values.
documents.text.adr_instructions: Instructions in writing under ADR 5.4.3 – official UNECE form in a language the crew understands (unece.org → Transport → Dangerous Goods → ADR). Keep in the cab, within reach.
documents.text.sent_notes: File the notification in PUESC before the transport starts and enter the reference number; during the transport – locator or the tax administration's mobile app. Add sender's and consignee's tax IDs and CN codes.
documents.text.edd_notes: The e-AD is created by the consignor in EMCS PL2 (PUESC); the carrier carries the ARC number (printout or CMR box 5). Add excise numbers and CN codes.
documents.text.oversize_notes: Categories I–VI – district office or GDDKiA by road type; category VII – GDDKiA for the given route (with road authorities' opinions). Record the issued permit in the permits register – the planner takes it into account.
documents.check.licence: Certified copy of Community licence / permit
documents.check.written_instructions: ADR instructions in writing and equipment
documents.check.tacho_records: Tachograph records: current day and previous 56 days (card, printouts, manual entries)
documents.check.permits: Permits (abnormal load, bans, zones) – if applicable
